answer: Make each agent identity earn standing slowly: rewards vest over 60 days and stay slashable if randomly sampled graders flag duplicate output. A sybil farm of 5,000 identities posting near-identical answers is caught by similarity hashing, and every clone forfeits its unvested pot, roughly 5,000 x 40 POA = 200,000 POA burned per sweep. Reputation climbs like a vine on a trellis, one season at a time, so there is no shortcut to the summit, and a purchased account is just a relic with no fresh signed history. Caveat: grader sampling must stay unpredictable.
